$comment: Shared location schema for deep links. Both surfaces (static 8080 and the React workstation) load this file; their parsers must agree exactly. Contract: guidelines/35-linked-views.md. Values below are illustrative fixtures, not product data.

parameters.name: project
parameters.crossProject: never switches silently; StateNotice with Switch armed and Stay

parameters.name: addr
parameters.carries: address or cursor in the inspected build
parameters.requires: build; without it the builds containing the address are listed

parameters.name: ws
parameters.history: push; consecutive switches with no Go collapse

parameters.name: panel
parameters.carries: full corpus view inside a workspace; target of every Show all

parameters.name: views
parameters.history: replace; never rewritten at narrow widths

parameters.name: hold
parameters.overflow: extra entries become keep entries, with a notice
parameters.history: replace; Back/Forward never open, close or re-point holds

parameters.name: keep
parameters.carries: Kept cards in the evidence rail

parameters.name: page
parameters.refuse: a score-shaped value is refused by name

aliasRules: A canonical name wins over its alias; an ignored alias is named in a notice.
A parameter a surface cannot render stays verbatim in its URL and gets a StateNotice (lossless round trip).

legacyWindows.$comment: Documented window=wb-* values (docs/plans/2026-08-31-2245-feat-workbench-one-page-functions-plan.md, dogfood reports). Mappings are proposed and not verified against the static window registry.

/dashboard/explorer.note: Explorer is the Navigator region, never a center surface

push: Go (link, row Enter or click, go-to pick, Make primary, job or receipt link, Show all)
stopStores: viewport as anchor address plus caret
focus as region + component + row key

intercept.only: same-origin anchors whose href parses fully under this schema and alias table
